sources.quote: June shows $49.18 billion refunded, compared to $23.63 billion collected, taking net customs revenue to a negative $25.56 billion.
sources.searcher_note: Same finding and same June numbers as the lead; also says May had $21.97B refunded vs $21.93B collected. Page updated 2026-09-01.

sources.quote: That figure handily beat the $23.6 billion in tariff revenue collected over the same period
sources.searcher_note: Earliest found: June 2026 refunds of $49.1B beat $23.6B collected, citing the Treasury monthly statement.

sources.quote: the Treasury collected $23.6 billion in customs duties in June, meaning the refunds resulted in a net outflow of $25.6 billion.
sources.searcher_note: June net customs outflow of $25.6B; $77.1B refunded in calendar 2026 to that point.

sources.quote: The Trump administration paid out a milestone $100 billion in tariff refunds through the end of July, according to a new court filing.
sources.searcher_note: Cumulative refunds $100B through July 31 (court filing); the lead's $113.5B is through Aug 7 from the daily statement.

sources.quote: The government has now paid out about $115 billion in total tariff refunds since May
sources.searcher_note: Cumulative ~$115B through August; says August was the first month since April in which tariff revenue exceeded refunds ($23.3B vs $10.5B).

sources.quote: approximately $122 billion (including interest) has been certified and transmitted to the U.S. Treasury for payment.
sources.searcher_note: Latest CBP status relayed: $122B certified and sent to Treasury (a different measure from refunds paid out).

notes: Several sources report the same May-June finding with the lead's June numbers ($49.18B / $23.63B / -$25.56B). Earliest found: Yahoo Finance 2026-07-13, after the 2026-06-30 cutoff. No source found for the Jun 29 single-day $35.49B figure or the FY2023-25 $40M-a-day baseline. Search snippets (CBO July Monthly Budget Review; Quartz) said July 2026 refunds also exceeded gross collections. Those pages were not opened or quoted: Quartz returned 403 and the CBO PDF was not fetched. The WWD/Sourcing Journal page redirected to a paywall host and was not opened.
